identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to extract kubelet credentials from a Windows endpoint, potentially enabling lateral movement or cluster compromise. Cortex should detect the execution of suspicious PowerShell commands and file access patterns.

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process execution with bypass policy

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: PowerShell Execution with Bypass Policy
biocs.description: Detection of PowerShell execution with -ExecutionPolicy Bypass flag
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '-ExecutionPolicy Bypass'

abiocs.name: Suspicious File Access After PowerShell Execution
abiocs.description: Detection of file access after PowerShell execution with bypass policy
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE_ACCESS
| filter action_file_path = 'C:\temp\kubeletcreds.txt'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'

xql_queries.name: PowerShell Execution with Bypass Policy
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '-ExecutionPolicy Bypass'
